# What this notebook does

It writes every number the ABS Explorer website shows. The website does no
statistics of its own beyond two things documented in the site's methodology
note: re-basing percentages from the valid to the asked denominator, and
averaging country estimates into regional lines.

| Output (in `public/data/`) | Content |
|---|---|
| `manifest.json` | survey, waves, countries (with fieldwork years), subgroups, country sets |
| `waves/w<n>/index.json` | the variable catalogue for wave *n* |
| `waves/w<n>/v/<var>.json` | weighted distributions, means and N by country × subgroup |
| `waves/w<n>/r/<var>.json` | within-country correlations of `<var>` with every eligible item |
| `trends/index.json`, `trends/<id>.json` | harmonized W1–W6 series from `HarmonizedMerge_v1` |

Every check is a `stopifnot()`, so **a knit that finishes means every check passed.**

**To rebuild:** set the data folder (the `Asian Barometer Data` folder, with the
`.sav` files downloaded locally, not iCloud placeholders) and knit from inside `pipeline/`:

```r
Sys.setenv(ABS_DATA_DIR = "~/Desktop/Larry RA/Asian Barometer Data")
rmarkdown::render("build_site_data.Rmd")
```

# Setup

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(haven); library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(purrr); library(data.table); library(jsonlite)
})
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
PIPELINE_DIR <- normalizePath(".")
for (f in sort(list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))) source(f)

countries <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "countries.csv"), colClasses = c(iso_numeric = "character"))
iso_of    <- setNames(countries$iso2, countries$abs_code)
sections  <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "sections.csv"))
overrides <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "variable_overrides.csv"))
fallbacks <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "fieldwork_year_fallbacks.csv"))
trend_ind <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG_DIR, "trend_indicators.csv"), colClasses = "character")

stopifnot(file.exists(CROSSWALK), file.exists(HARMONIZED), all(file.exists(wave_file(WAVES$wave))))
sources <- tibble(file = c(basename(wave_file(WAVES$wave)), basename(HARMONIZED), basename(CROSSWALK)),
                  md5 = c(md5(wave_file(WAVES$wave)), md5(HARMONIZED), md5(CROSSWALK)))
sources

# Write into a staging folder; it replaces public/data/{waves,trends,manifest.json}
# only after every check below has passed, so a failed build never leaves the site
# with partial data.
FINAL_DIR <- OUT_DIR
OUT_DIR <- file.path(tempdir(), "site-data")
unlink(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE); dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(REVIEW_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Harmonized merge and crosswalk

```{r harmonized}
hm_raw <- read_sav(HARMONIZED)
hm <- as.data.frame(lapply(hm_raw, function(x) if (is.character(x)) x else as.numeric(zap_labels(x))))
cw <- read_crosswalk()
cat("HarmonizedMerge_v1:", nrow(hm), "respondents ×", ncol(hm), "columns\n")
cw$xw |> count(category, ts) |> pivot_wider(names_from = ts, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

# Single-wave estimates

For each wave: read the file, check it lines up row-for-row with
`HarmonizedMerge_v1` (the subgroup variables come from there), classify every
variable, then write one file per variable.

```{r waves}
urban_from_raw <- function(x) {
  labs <- attr(x, "labels"); xv <- as.numeric(zap_labels(x))
  lab_of <- norm_label(names(labs))[match(xv, as.numeric(labs))]
  case_when(lab_of == "urban" ~ 1, lab_of == "rural" ~ 2, TRUE ~ NA_real_)
}

catalogues <- list(); wave_meta <- list(); file_sizes <- list()

for (w in WAVES$wave) {
  wv <- WAVES[WAVES$wave == w, ]
  d  <- read_wave(w)
  h  <- hm[hm$wave == w, ]
  # ---- alignment with HarmonizedMerge_v1 (source of the subgroup variables)
  stopifnot(nrow(d) == nrow(h),
            all(as.integer(zap_labels(d$country)) == h$country),
            all(as.character(zap_labels(d$idnumber)) == h$idnumber))
  cty <- unname(iso_of[as.character(as.integer(zap_labels(d[[wv$country_var]])))])
  wt  <- as.numeric(zap_labels(d[[wv$weight_var]]))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(cty), !anyNA(wt), all(wt > 0))
  # weights are within-country and average 1 in every country
  stopifnot(all(abs(tapply(wt, cty, mean) - 1) < 0.01))

  demo <- data.frame(se_gender = h$se_gender, se_age = h$se_age, se_education = h$se_education,
                     urban = urban_from_raw(d[[URBAN_SOURCE[[as.character(w)]]]]))
  memb <- build_memberships(demo)

  cat_w <- build_catalogue(w, d, sections, overrides)
  harm_w <- cw$rules |> filter(wave == w, rule != "exclude") |> select(variable = source_variable, harmonized_id)
  cat_w <- cat_w |> left_join(harm_w |> distinct(variable, .keep_all = TRUE), by = "variable")
  show <- cat_w |> filter(type %in% c("ordinal", "binary", "continuous", "nominal"))

  index_vars <- list(); corr_cols <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(show))) {
    v <- show$variable[i]; ty <- show$type[i]; x <- d[[v]]
    ct <- code_table(x)
    xv <- as.numeric(zap_labels(x))
    cls <- ct$class[match(xv, ct$code)]
    cls[is.na(xv)] <- "not_asked"
    sub <- ct |> filter(class %in% c("substantive", "offscale")) |> arrange(class != "substantive", code)
    nr <- ct |> filter(class == "nonresponse")
    with_mean <- ty != "nominal"
    if (ty == "continuous") {
      bins <- make_bins(xv[cls == "substantive"])
      xbin <- bin_index(xv, bins)
      codes <- seq_along(bins$labels); labels <- bins$labels
    } else {
      xbin <- NULL; codes <- sub$code
      labels <- ifelse(is.na(sub$label), format(sub$code, trim = TRUE), sub$label)
    }
    sparse <- ty == "nominal" && length(codes) > 25
    est <- estimate_cells(xv, cls, codes, nr$code, cty, wt, memb, with_mean, xbin, sparse)
    asked <- names(est)[vapply(est, function(e) (e$all$nv %||% 0) > 0, logical(1))]
    if (!length(asked)) next
    est <- est[asked]
    rec <- list(id = v, wave = w, type = ty, codes = arr(codes), labels = arr(labels),
                nr = arr(nr$code), nr_labels = arr(nr$label), sparse = sparse, est = est)
    if (ty != "continuous" && any(sub$class == "offscale")) rec$offscale <- arr(sub$code[sub$class == "offscale"])
    if (ty == "continuous") rec$range <- arr(range(xv[cls == "substantive"], na.rm = TRUE))
    file_sizes[[length(file_sizes) + 1]] <- tibble(wave = w, kind = "v", id = v,
      bytes = write_json_compact(rec, file.path(OUT_DIR, "waves", paste0("w", w), "v", paste0(v, ".json"))))
    entry <- list(id = v, q = show$label[i], s = show$section[i], t = ty,
                  k = length(codes), c = arr(asked))
    if (!is.na(show$harmonized_id[i])) entry$h <- show$harmonized_id[i]
    if (ty == "ordinal") {
      on <- sub$label[sub$class == "substantive"]; oc <- sub$code[sub$class == "substantive"]
      entry$ends <- arr(c(sprintf("%g = %s", oc[1], on[1]), sprintf("%g = %s", oc[length(oc)], on[length(on)])))
    }
    index_vars[[length(index_vars) + 1]] <- entry
    if (with_mean) corr_cols[[v]] <- ifelse(cls == "substantive", xv, NA_real_)
  }

  # ---- correlations (within country, pairwise, weighted)
  corr_vars <- names(corr_cols)
  X <- do.call(cbind, corr_cols); colnames(X) <- corr_vars
  cor_by_cty <- lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(X)), cty), function(rows) weighted_pairwise_cor(X[rows, , drop = FALSE], wt[rows]))
  # keep only items with at least MIN_PAIR_N valid answers in some country
  keep_v <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(cor_by_cty, function(cc) diag(cc$n) >= MIN_PAIR_N))
  if (!all(keep_v)) {
    X <- X[, keep_v, drop = FALSE]; corr_vars <- corr_vars[keep_v]
    cor_by_cty <- lapply(cor_by_cty, function(cc) list(r = cc$r[keep_v, keep_v, drop = FALSE], n = cc$n[keep_v, keep_v, drop = FALSE]))
  }
  for (j in seq_along(corr_vars)) {
    rr <- lapply(cor_by_cty, function(cc) arr(as.integer(round(1000 * cc$r[j, ])))); nn <- lapply(cor_by_cty, function(cc) arr(as.integer(cc$n[j, ])))
    # drop countries where the item was not asked
    keep <- names(rr)[vapply(cor_by_cty, function(cc) cc$n[j, j] >= MIN_PAIR_N, logical(1))]
    file_sizes[[length(file_sizes) + 1]] <- tibble(wave = w, kind = "r", id = corr_vars[j],
      bytes = write_json_compact(list(id = corr_vars[j], r = rr[keep], n = nn[keep]),
                                 file.path(OUT_DIR, "waves", paste0("w", w), "r", paste0(corr_vars[j], ".json"))))
  }
  assign(paste0("cor_w", w), list(X = X, cty = cty, wt = wt, res = cor_by_cty))

  section_order <- unique(c(sections$section[sections$wave == w],
                            "Socio-economic Background", "Interview Record", "Sample Design", "Other questions"))
  file_sizes[[length(file_sizes) + 1]] <- tibble(wave = w, kind = "index", id = "index",
    bytes = write_json_compact(list(wave = w, sections = arr(intersect(section_order, unique(show$section))),
                                    corr = arr(corr_vars), vars = index_vars),
                               file.path(OUT_DIR, "waves", paste0("w", w), "index.json")))
  wave_meta[[w]] <- list(n = nrow(d), countries = sort(unique(cty)),
                         country_n = as.list(table(cty)))
  catalogues[[w]] <- cat_w
  cat(sprintf("W%d: %d rows, %d variables shown (%s), %d correlatable\n", w, nrow(d), length(index_vars),
              paste(names(table(show$type)), table(show$type), sep = "=", collapse = ", "), length(corr_vars)))
}
catalogue <- bind_rows(catalogues)
write.csv(catalogue, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "catalogue_review.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
catalogue |> count(wave, type) |> pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

# Harmonized trends

Only crosswalk rows marked **Include in Time Series = YES** with a numeric scale.

```{r trends}
ts_items <- cw$xw |> filter(ts == "YES", suppressWarnings(!is.na(as.numeric(points))))
fy <- fieldwork_years(hm, fallbacks, iso_of)
raw_waves <- lapply(WAVES$wave, read_wave)
hm_cty <- unname(iso_of[as.character(hm$country)])
trend_index <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ts_items))) {
  it <- ts_items[i, ]; id <- it$id; pts <- as.integer(it$points)
  labels <- parse_scale_labels(it$scale, pts)
  per_wave <- list(); src <- list()
  for (w in WAVES$wave) {
    r <- cw$rules |> filter(harmonized_id == id, wave == w)
    if (!nrow(r) || r$rule == "exclude") next
    rows <- which(hm$wave == w)
    x <- hm[[id]][rows]
    raw <- raw_waves[[w]][[r$source_variable]]
    ct <- code_table(raw); rawv <- as.numeric(zap_labels(raw))
    raw_cls <- ct$class[match(rawv, ct$code)]
    cls <- ifelse(!is.na(x), "substantive", ifelse(!is.na(raw_cls) & raw_cls == "nonresponse", "nonresponse", "not_asked"))
    x[cls == "nonresponse"] <- -99
    demo <- data.frame(se_gender = hm$se_gender[rows], se_age = hm$se_age[rows], se_education = hm$se_education[rows],
                       urban = urban_from_raw(raw_waves[[w]][[URBAN_SOURCE[[as.character(w)]]]]))
    est <- estimate_cells(x, cls, seq_len(pts), -99, hm_cty[rows], hm$weight[rows], build_memberships(demo), TRUE)
    est <- est[vapply(est, function(e) (e$all$nv %||% 0) > 0, logical(1))]
    if (!length(est)) next
    per_wave[[as.character(w)]] <- est
    src[[as.character(w)]] <- list(var = r$source_variable, rule = r$rule, map = r$code_map %||% NA)
  }
  ind <- default_indicator(id, pts, labels, trend_ind)
  file_sizes[[length(file_sizes) + 1]] <- tibble(wave = 0, kind = "trend", id = id,
    bytes = write_json_compact(list(id = id, codes = arr(seq_len(pts)), labels = arr(labels), waves = per_wave),
                               file.path(OUT_DIR, "trends", paste0(id, ".json"))))
  trend_index[[length(trend_index) + 1]] <- list(id = id, cat = it$category, q = it$question,
    points = pts, labels = arr(labels), default = ind, mean_ok = ind$mean_ok, src = src,
    notes = if (is.na(it$notes)) "" else it$notes, waves = arr(as.integer(names(per_wave))))
}
write_json_compact(list(source = basename(CROSSWALK), items = trend_index), file.path(OUT_DIR, "trends", "index.json"))
cat(length(trend_index), "harmonized time-series items written\n")
```

# Manifest

```{r manifest}
ctry_json <- list()
for (k in seq_len(nrow(countries))) {
  iso <- countries$iso2[k]
  waves_in <- Filter(function(w) iso %in% wave_meta[[w]]$countries, WAVES$wave)
  if (!length(waves_in)) next
  wl <- list()
  for (w in waves_in) {
    f <- fy |> filter(wave == w, iso2 == iso)
    stopifnot(nrow(f) == 1)
    wl[[as.character(w)]] <- list(n = wave_meta[[w]]$country_n[[iso]], year = f$year,
                                  span = arr(c(f$y_lo, f$y_hi)), year_source = f$source)
  }
  ctry_json[[iso]] <- list(name = countries$name[k], iso3 = countries$iso3[k],
                           iso_numeric = countries$iso_numeric[k], waves = wl)
}
subgroups_json <- lapply(SUBGROUPS, function(s) list(id = s$id, label = s$label,
  groups = lapply(s$groups, function(g) list(id = g$id, label = g$label))))
manifest <- list(
  schema = "barometer-explorer/2",
  survey = SURVEY,
  built = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d"),
  sources = sources,
  waves = lapply(WAVES$wave, function(w) list(id = w, label = WAVES$label[w], years = WAVES$years[w],
                                              n = wave_meta[[w]]$n, countries = arr(wave_meta[[w]]$countries))),
  countries = ctry_json,
  subgroups = subgroups_json,
  country_sets = COUNTRY_SETS,
  default_set = DEFAULT_SET,
  min_cell_n = MIN_CELL_N,
  n_trends = length(trend_index)
)
write_json_compact(manifest, file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json"))
```

# Checks

## Every cell adds up

For every written distribution: percentages over valid respondents sum to 100
(within rounding), unweighted counts sum to the valid N, nonresponse shares lie
in 0–100, and means lie within the code range.

```{r check-cells}
check_file <- function(path) {
  rec <- fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  bad <- character()
  for (cc in names(rec$est)) for (g in names(rec$est[[cc]])) {
    e <- rec$est[[cc]][[g]]
    if (e$nv > 0) {
      p <- unlist(e$p); cnt <- unlist(e$c)
      if (abs(sum(p) - 100) > 0.05 * length(p) + 0.1) bad <- c(bad, paste(cc, g, "p-sum", sum(p)))
      if (sum(cnt) != e$nv) bad <- c(bad, paste(cc, g, "count-sum"))
      if (!is.null(e$m)) {
        lo <- if (rec$type == "continuous") unlist(rec$range)[1] else min(unlist(rec$codes))
        hi <- if (rec$type == "continuous") unlist(rec$range)[2] else max(unlist(rec$codes))
        if (e$m < lo - 1e-9 || e$m > hi + 1e-9) bad <- c(bad, paste(cc, g, "mean-range"))
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(e$q)) { q <- unlist(e$q); if (any(q < 0 | q > 100) || sum(q) > 100.1) bad <- c(bad, paste(cc, g, "q")) }
    if (e$n < e$nv) bad <- c(bad, paste(cc, g, "n<nv"))
  }
  if (length(bad)) paste(basename(path), paste(head(bad, 3), collapse = "; ")) else NULL
}
all_files <- c(list.files(file.path(OUT_DIR, "waves"), pattern = "\\.json$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE) |>
                 grep(pattern = "/v/", value = TRUE),
               list.files(file.path(OUT_DIR, "trends"), full.names = TRUE) |> setdiff(file.path(OUT_DIR, "trends", "index.json")))
problems <- unlist(lapply(all_files[!grepl("/trends/", all_files)], check_file))
cat(length(all_files), "files checked;", length(problems), "problems\n"); head(problems)
stopifnot(length(problems) == 0)
```

## Independent recomputation of 300 random cells

A second, deliberately naive implementation (base R `tapply` on the raw file,
labels classified again from scratch) must reproduce the written percentages and means.

```{r check-random}
set.seed(20260930)
recheck <- map_dfr(1:300, function(k) {
  w <- sample(WAVES$wave, 1); d <- raw_waves[[w]]
  idx <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "waves", paste0("w", w), "index.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  e <- sample(Filter(function(z) z$t %in% c("ordinal", "binary"), idx$vars), 1)[[1]]
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "waves", paste0("w", w), "v", paste0(e$id, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  cc <- sample(names(rec$est), 1)
  x <- d[[e$id]]; xv <- as.numeric(zap_labels(x))
  ct <- code_table(x)                                   # shared code classification
  valid <- xv %in% ct$code[ct$class %in% c("substantive", "offscale")]
  on_scale <- xv %in% ct$code[ct$class == "substantive"]
  ww <- as.numeric(zap_labels(d[[WAVES$weight_var[w]]]))
  in_c <- unname(iso_of[as.character(as.integer(zap_labels(d$country)))]) == cc
  inc <- in_c & valid
  pct <- tapply(ww[inc], xv[inc], sum) / sum(ww[inc]) * 100
  mine <- setNames(unlist(rec$est[[cc]]$all$p), unlist(rec$codes))
  tibble(wave = w, var = e$id, country = cc,
         max_pct_diff = max(abs(mine[names(pct)] - pct), na.rm = TRUE),
         mean_diff = abs(rec$est[[cc]]$all$m - weighted.mean(xv[in_c & on_scale], ww[in_c & on_scale])))
})
summary(recheck$max_pct_diff); summary(recheck$mean_diff)
stopifnot(all(recheck$max_pct_diff <= 0.051), all(recheck$mean_diff < 0.0006))
```

## Trends match `HarmonizedMerge_v1` directly

Country means for every harmonized item × wave, recomputed with `dplyr` from the
merge, must equal the written trend files. The Japan W1 economy item is the
known error on the March 2026 site (it showed 4.55 of 5, "very good"): it must now be below 3.

```{r check-trends}
direct <- map_dfr(trend_index, function(t) {
  hm |> filter(!is.na(.data[[t$id]])) |> mutate(iso = unname(iso_of[as.character(country)])) |>
    group_by(wave, iso) |> summarise(m = weighted.mean(.data[[t$id]], weight), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(id = t$id)
})
written <- map_dfr(trend_index, function(t) {
  rec <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "trends", paste0(t$id, ".json")), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  imap_dfr(rec$waves, function(wd, w) imap_dfr(wd, function(e, iso) tibble(wave = as.numeric(w), iso = iso, m_file = e$all$m))) |>
    mutate(id = t$id)
})
cmp <- inner_join(direct, written, by = c("id", "wave", "iso"))
stopifnot(nrow(cmp) == nrow(direct), max(abs(cmp$m - cmp$m_file)) < 0.0006)
cat("Compared", nrow(cmp), "country × wave means; max abs diff", signif(max(abs(cmp$m - cmp$m_file)), 2), "\n")
jp_w1 <- cmp |> filter(id == "econ_national_current", wave == 1, iso == "JP")
jp_w1
stopifnot(jp_w1$m_file < 3)
```

## Correlations match `stats::cov.wt`

```{r check-corr}
set.seed(7)
corr_check <- map_dfr(WAVES$wave, function(w) {
  cw_ <- get(paste0("cor_w", w))
  map_dfr(1:40, function(k) {
    cc <- sample(names(cw_$res), 1); rows <- which(cw_$cty == cc)
    j <- sample(ncol(cw_$X), 2)
    ref <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(cor_reference(cw_$X[rows, j[1]], cw_$X[rows, j[2]], cw_$wt[rows]), error = function(e) NA))
    tibble(wave = w, country = cc, a = colnames(cw_$X)[j[1]], b = colnames(cw_$X)[j[2]],
           mine = cw_$res[[cc]]$r[j[1], j[2]], ref = ref)
  })
}) |> filter(!is.na(mine))
cat(nrow(corr_check), "pairs compared; max abs diff", signif(max(abs(corr_check$mine - corr_check$ref)), 2), "\n")
stopifnot(max(abs(corr_check$mine - corr_check$ref)) < 1e-8)
```

## Nothing meaningless reaches the site

```{r check-types}
idx_all <- map_dfr(WAVES$wave, function(w) {
  idx <- fromJSON(file.path(OUT_DIR, "waves", paste0("w", w), "index.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  tibble(wave = w, id = map_chr(idx$vars, "id"), type = map_chr(idx$vars, "t"),
         in_corr = map_chr(idx$vars, "id") %in% unlist(idx$corr))
})
stopifnot(!any(grepl(ADMIN_VARS_RX, idx_all$id)),               # no ids, weights, dates
          !any(idx_all$in_corr & idx_all$type == "nominal"))      # no nominal item is correlated
# ordered items left out of correlations: only those with < MIN_PAIR_N answers in every country
idx_all |> filter(!in_corr, type != "nominal")
idx_all |> count(wave, type) |> pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

## Countries per wave agree with the crosswalk's coverage sheet

```{r check-countries}
cov <- read_excel(CROSSWALK, sheet = "Country Coverage") |> filter(!is.na(Country), !is.na(`Country Code`)) |>
  pivot_longer(W1:W6, names_to = "wave", values_to = "yes") |>
  transmute(iso = unname(iso_of[as.character(`Country Code`)]), wave = as.integer(sub("W", "", wave)), sheet = yes == "YES")
data_cov <- map_dfr(WAVES$wave, function(w) tibble(iso = wave_meta[[w]]$countries, wave = w, data = TRUE))
disagree <- full_join(cov, data_cov, by = c("iso", "wave")) |> mutate(data = coalesce(data, FALSE)) |> filter(sheet != data)
disagree   # expected: Cambodia W5 (listed YES; not in Wave5.sav)
stopifnot(nrow(disagree) <= 1, all(disagree$iso == "KH"))
```

## Payload sizes

```{r sizes}
sizes <- bind_rows(file_sizes)
sizes |> group_by(kind) |> summarise(files = n(), total_MB = round(sum(bytes) / 1e6, 1),
                                     median_KB = round(median(bytes) / 1e3, 1), max_KB = round(max(bytes) / 1e3, 1))
sizes |> arrange(desc(bytes)) |> head(8)
write.csv(sizes, file.path(REVIEW_DIR, "file_sizes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Publish

All checks passed, so the staged files replace the site's data.

```{r publish}
for (d in c("waves", "trends")) unlink(file.path(FINAL_DIR, d), recursive = TRUE)
for (d in c("waves", "trends")) stopifnot(file.rename(file.path(OUT_DIR, d), file.path(FINAL_DIR, d)) ||
                                          file.copy(file.path(OUT_DIR, d), FINAL_DIR, recursive = TRUE))
file.copy(file.path(OUT_DIR, "manifest.json"), file.path(FINAL_DIR, "manifest.json"), overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Published to", normalizePath(FINAL_DIR), "\n")
```
